def sample_batch(user_train: dict, itemnum: int, batch_size: int, maxlen: int):
    # DEBUG: No traceback was supplied; this fixes a confirmed sampling issue.
    # Recreating a seed-42 sampler on every call repeated the identical batch,
    # making multiple diagnostic batches duplicate measurements. Retain one
    # sampler while preserving the B x L, single-negative loader contract.
    sampler = getattr(sample_batch, "_sampler", None)
    if (
        sampler is None
        or sampler.histories is not user_train
        or sampler.itemnum != itemnum
        or sampler.maxlen != maxlen
    ):
        sampler = TrainingSampler(user_train, itemnum, maxlen)
        sample_batch._sampler = sampler
    seq, pos, neg, _ = sampler.sample(batch_size, 1)
    return seq, pos, neg[:, :, 0]
